datasets.name: leads
datasets.description: Every enquiry (one per touch). Merged duplicate touches keep mergedIntoLeadId and status lost (lostReasonCode duplicate); exclude them from conversion maths. Configurator leads are test-drive bookings from the configurator.
datasets.refresh: Nightly 02:00 Australia/Sydney (DMS export); API writes are live

columns.name: customerId
columns.description: customers.id; null only for anonymous configurator bookings that never turned up

columns.name: customerRef
columns.description: Configurator session id when customerId is null

columns.name: source
columns.description: Marketing source: showroom, service-department, referral, repeat-customer, drive-by, google, toyota.com.au, harbourline.com.au, carsales, google-ads, facebook, <channel>-campaign, web-configurator

columns.name: status
columns.description: new | contacted | qualified | test_drive_booked | quoted | won | lost

columns.name: finderAnswers
columns.description: [{ id, value }] finder answers (use, people, towing, power, budget, when …)

columns.name: viewed
columns.description: [{ modelId, gradeId, unitId }] cars looked at in the configurator

columns.name: mergedIntoLeadId
columns.description: Primary lead this duplicate touch was merged into

columns.name: lostReasonCode
columns.description: Lead: no_response, invalid, researching, budget, wait_time, bought_elsewhere, duplicate, used_car, not_suitable, deferred. Deal codes when lost as a deal.

datasets.name: test_drives
datasets.description: Test drives booked from leads (configurator bookings carry the handover sheet and incentive). No-shows are rebooked about half the time.
datasets.refresh: Nightly 02:00 Australia/Sydney (DMS export); API writes are live

columns.name: questions
columns.description: [{ id, question, answer }] the three pre-visit questions

columns.name: handover
columns.description: Salesperson handover sheet: car, viewed, finderAnswers, promotionsToOffer, incentive, talkingPoints

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: quoted | considering | not_for_them | second_drive_requested | no_show | cancelled_by_customer | rescheduled

datasets.name: deals
datasets.description: Desked deals from quote to delivery. frontGross = vehiclePrice − discount − bonus − landedCost + accessoriesGross − promotionCost − tradeOverAllowance; backGross = finance commission + insurance/warranty products; grossProfit = front + back. Only stage = delivered is realised gross.
datasets.refresh: Nightly 02:00 Australia/Sydney (DMS export); API writes are live

columns.name: id
columns.description: D-##### (D-10482 and D-10517 are the document-processing demo contracts)

columns.name: businessManagerId
columns.description: staff.id of the F&I manager when financed

columns.name: stockNo
columns.description: vehicles.stockNo for stock/allocated units or the unit being quoted

columns.name: order
columns.description: { modelId, gradeId, colourId, etaWeeks, stockNo? } for allocated/factory orders and order quotes

columns.name: stage
columns.description: quote | negotiation | finance | approval | contract | delivery | delivered | lost

columns.name: tradeOverAllowance
columns.description: Trade offered above valuation (excl. promotion bonus), charged to front gross

columns.name: driveAway
columns.description: vehiclePrice + onRoadCosts + accessoriesTotal − bonus − discount (before trade-in)

columns.name: lostReasonCode
columns.description: price | other_toyota | competitor | wait_time | finance_declined | trade_gap | deferred | no_response

columns.name: lostStage
columns.description: Stage the deal was lost from

columns.name: events
columns.description: [{ at, type, note, staffId }] timeline with human notes (flattened in deal_events)

columns.name: demo
columns.description: document-processing for the two demo contracts

datasets.name: trade_ins

datasets.name: finance_apps
datasets.description: Finance applications. Declines are resubmitted to a second lender most of the time (sequence 2). Approval rates: Toyota Finance ≈ 90%, Macquarie ≈ 85%, ANZ ≈ 80%, Westpac ≈ 75%.

columns.name: amount
